# Packard Promo — Tanzania's Printing, Signage & Promotional Products Marketplace

## About
Packard Promo is Tanzania's leading online marketplace for printing, signage, packaging, vehicle branding and promotional products. We provide professional printing services, signage solutions, packaging, promotional products and corporate branding for businesses across Tanzania.

## Services
- Digital Printing
- Offset Printing
- Large Format Printing
- Packaging Printing
- Signage Solutions
- Vehicle Branding
- Promotional Products
- Exhibition & Events
- Design Studio

## Products
- Business Cards
- Banners & Roll-up Banners
- T-shirts & Apparel
- Corporate Gifts
- Shop Signboards
- Vehicle Wraps
- Labels & Stickers
- Packaging Boxes
- Brochures & Flyers
- Posters & Flyers

## Locations
- Headquarters: Fire Area, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
- Service coverage: Dar es Salaam, Zanzibar, Arusha, Mwanza, Dodoma, Mbeya, Morogoro, Tanga
